scientific_limitations_integrity: The theorem is for nearest-neighbor finite cycles of order at least three, equal species hopping, no coherent interparticle interactions, and positive loss at every coincidence vertex. It does not quantify finite-time convergence or treat magnetic flux, rate zeros, disorder, or incomplete detector support. General Fourier and dissipativity steps are analytically proved; finite verifications are corroborative. The source priority search is not an exhaustive publication guarantee.
title: Parity-exact reaction probabilities for two quantum walkers on a cycle
